blocks.x: CIB margins compress while deal complexity grows: origination research, credit memos, trade documentation and risk reporting all consume expensive analyst hours that agentic systems can compress — with the control discipline investment banks cannot compromise.

The workflows we industrialize here: Credit memo production, Trade document handling, Intraday risk aggregation, Client onboarding (institutional), Collateral management. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Pitch books, credit memos and research notes re-type data from terminals and filings; quality varies by analyst stamina.
LCs, trade documents and settlement instructions fail on reference mismatches; exception queues run through time zones.
Counterparty, market and collateral views assemble overnight; intraday exposures are estimates.
Deal rooms and research estates hold market-moving data; insider-risk and exfiltration controls are uneven.
Monte Carlo and VaR grids hit compute ceilings on stress days; desks fly blind exactly when it matters.
Booking and risk platforms resist change; product launch becomes a program.
